parental_allowed_hint.message: One site per line, for example wikipedia.org. The parental filter never blocks these. Your own rules still apply.

parental_blocked_allow.message: A parent can allow this site

parental_blocked_heading.message: This page is blocked by parental controls

parental_blocked_reason.message: A parent or guardian has set this browser to keep explicit content away. If you think this is a mistake, ask them to take a look.

parental_feat_images.message: Scans images on this device with a built-in classifier, blurs explicit ones and blocks pages that show several.

parental_feat_known.message: Blocks $1 known adult sites, with their subdomains.

parental_feat_pages.message: Checks each page on this device for explicit content (adult-content labels, words in the title, address and text) and blocks it. It can learn a whole site from one page.

parental_feat_safe.message: Turns on SafeSearch for Google, Bing and DuckDuckGo, and YouTube Restricted Mode.

parental_feat_social.message: Hides individual NSFW or sensitive posts in social feeds, so the rest of the site still works.

parental_forget_all_body.message: They open again until a page on them is detected again.

parental_incog_1.message: Open chrome://extensions in the address bar.

parental_incog_body.message: Chrome does not run extensions in Incognito unless you allow it, so a child could open an Incognito window to get around the filter.

parental_incog_policy.message: Or turn Incognito off entirely with the Chrome policy IncognitoModeAvailability=1.

parental_learned_hint.message: Sites blocked because one of their pages was detected. Only the site name is kept.

parental_limits_detect.message: On-device detection can miss content or flag a safe page. If a safe site is blocked, a guardian can allow it with the PIN, here or on the block page.

parental_limits_policy.message: For real enforcement, use Google Family Link, or Chrome policies on this computer:

parental_limits_remove.message: Anyone who can open chrome://extensions can turn off or remove any extension, including this one. The PIN protects settings inside FocusGuard, not the extension itself.

parental_ob_more.message: Fine-tune sensitivity, allowed sites and more later under Parental controls.

parental_ob_persona.message: For a browser a child uses

parental_ob_pinHint.message: At least 4 characters. Keep it from the child: it is needed to change or turn off parental controls.

parental_ob_pinMismatch.message: The two guardian PINs do not match.

parental_ob_pinShort.message: The guardian PIN needs at least 4 characters.

parental_ob_privacy.message: With parental controls on, pages and images are checked on this device only. Only the names of sites it learns to block are kept; nothing is sent anywhere.

parental_ob_summary.message: Blocks known adult sites, checks pages and images on this device for explicit content, hides NSFW posts in social feeds and turns on SafeSearch. A guardian PIN protects these settings.

parental_off_confirm_body.message: Known sites, page and image checks, feed filtering and SafeSearch all stop. Learned sites are kept for when you turn it on again.

parental_off_hint.message: Turning parental controls off needs the PIN.

parental_off_lead.message: Turn this on for a browser a child uses. A guardian PIN protects every parental setting.

parental_off_title.message: Keep explicit content away from a child

parental_opt_hide.message: Hide pages until they are checked

parental_opt_hide_hint.message: Stops explicit content flashing on screen. Pages can appear a moment later.

parental_opt_images_hint.message: Blurs explicit images and blocks pages that show several. Uses more processing power.

parental_opt_pages_hint.message: Looks at adult-content labels and words in the title, address and text, on this device.

parental_opt_safe.message: Force SafeSearch and YouTube Restricted Mode

parental_opt_safe_hint.message: Google, Bing and DuckDuckGo results are filtered; YouTube hides mature videos.

parental_opt_social_hint.message: Hides individual NSFW or sensitive posts (for example on Reddit and X) instead of blocking the whole site.

parental_pin_hint.message: At least $1 characters. Keep it from the child.

parental_pin_kept.message: Your earlier guardian PIN is still set and will be used.

parental_pin_mismatch.message: The two PINs do not match.

parental_pin_short.message: The PIN needs at least $1 characters.

parental_privacy_body.message: Pages and images are checked on this device only. FocusGuard keeps just the names of sites it learns to block, never page text, images or addresses, and sends nothing anywhere.

parental_scope_page_hint.message: Other pages on the same site stay open and are checked one by one.

parental_scope_site.message: Block the whole site once a page is detected

parental_scope_site_hint.message: FocusGuard learns the site and blocks it before it loads next time.

parental_sens_high_hint.message: Also suggestive content, and images stay blurred until checked. Best for young children; more false alarms.

parental_sens_low_hint.message: Only clearly explicit pages and images. Fewest false alarms.

parental_sens_medium_hint.message: Explicit pages and images, plus strongly suggestive ones. Recommended.

parental_status_line.message: $1 of 5 filters on · sensitivity $2 · $3 learned sites · $4 extra words · $5 allowed sites

parental_status_pin.message: Every change on this page asks for the guardian PIN.

parental_status_title.message: Parental controls are protecting this browser

parental_words_hint.message: One per line, up to $1. A page that uses one of these words counts as explicit.

parental_words_many.message: Use at most $1 blocked words (you have $2).
